intro: Compare options with common criteria and set out their advantages, costs and conditions.

texto: A comparative report first explains its criteria and assesses each option against the same ones. Separate initial costs from long-term consequences and attribute figures to the corresponding source.

frases.estudio: Optie A vervangt alle straatlampen binnen één jaar door ledverlichting.
frases.alumno: Option A replaces all street lamps with LED lighting within one year.

frases.estudio: De investering is hoog, maar het energiegebruik daalt volgens de raming direct.
frases.alumno: The investment is high, but according to the estimate energy use falls immediately.

frases.estudio: Optie B vervangt lampen wanneer onderhoud nodig is.
frases.alumno: Option B replaces lamps when maintenance is needed.

frases.estudio: Daardoor zijn de jaarlijkse uitgaven lager, terwijl de besparing geleidelijker ontstaat.
frases.alumno: This way annual spending is lower, although the saving comes about more gradually.

frases.estudio: De keuze hangt af van beschikbare middelen, energietarieven en de verwachte levensduur van de installaties.
frases.alumno: The decision depends on available funds, energy tariffs and the expected lifespan.
